body:
SHARED BOUNDARY CONTRACT — Engram and TermAl. Greg's direction: unify existing solutions and make processes universal across projects and supported hosts. Source and joint plan: Engram w-d7826c4f78ec, TermAl w-a08b0320448f. These are current design/operating rules, not new execution or landing authority.

Use one producer-owned specification of the existing wire contract, referenced by both projects. For every crossing field record its semantic role, producer, supported wire form, equality/normalization, project/store/host scope and normal/recovery/reload consumers. Reuse existing types/schemas and one validator per semantic kind per side; remove divergent copies instead of adding per-call assumptions.

Keep record identity separate from content fingerprints. New Engram record ids are32lowerhex; existing64lowerhex ids remain opaque and unchanged. SHA256/content-v1/Git/review fingerprints compare content, never mint or replace record ids. A64record id and SHA256 may share syntax; field/producer/provenance and existing semantic checks decide meaning. Never pad, truncate, rehash or relink stored ids, or force all identities into one textual format. Fingerprint callers retain their fingerprint validator.

Reuse the existing lifecycle and owners end-to-end: TermAl executes/captures; Engram records and returns actual receipt ids; TermAl settles/exposes them; verification read/evaluation/completion follow their existing contracts where applicable. Normal, recovery, reload and carried paths obey the same correlation/idempotency rules. Unknown retries the identical intent/key, not the test run. Missing evidence/refusals stay explicit; exit0, summaries or a closed grant are not evidence. OFF observations create no gated authority or test credit.

For Git task-sync identity, keep ONE logical Engram origin per explicitly enrolled project-local writable store, minted as an additive canonical record; ordinary open never enrolls it and display --origin-machine stays asserted. A copied UUID is not proof of the physical SQLite file. w-952b's same-serving-file observation must not create a second logical store ID or become an unsafe prerequisite for ordinary sync. Reuse the E1 binding/event/receipt owner plus private intent/feed-anchor/ref custody to detect observed continuity loss, including SAME-origin database rewind; missing proof quarantines pending exchange, never silently re-enrolls a clone. Full rollback of DB plus all independent witnesses is not locally distinguishable and must not be claimed detectable. Current optional design/migration matrix is w-01a67dade6f5 note0217e1a97a4b4ff4959b476d0803d514 (Fable#242 additive choice): existing rows/IDs/links retire/map/rewrite0, no DDL/required-row/projection change, no format conversion or readiness/cutover solely for missing origin. Any actual durable-shape delta returns to the existing migration decision before code. The E1 foundation presentation w-01a67dade6f5 note47204101552842ae85331d1d14b9e32d resolves M1: SQLite is progress authority from the start; Git-admin pending intents and retention refs are custody only. import_receipt is an exchange_event variant. This is a design target, not shipped identity or R4 recovery proof.

Preserve actual project/store, source host/native session, work/run/claim/fence, root generation and result/attempt scope as applicable. Reuse supported authenticated federation and remote admission; local receipts do not create remote authority. Routine builds/restarts add no security qualification or approval gate.

Conformance belongs in existing suites and uses actual producer output or provenance-preserved producer wire against the real consumer. Generate ids/fingerprints at test time, never pin hashes. Cover representative32/64/mixed records, malformed/partial/duplicate receipts, fingerprint fields, semantic/scope mismatches, same-key replay, restart/reload and duplicate/reordered delivery; assert associations and no duplicate effects. Reuse ordinary supported remote work for a peer case; no exhaustive matrix, manual manifest/export duty, extra sequential proof gate or mandatory canary. Concrete defect fixes and gated-control restoration continue independently; coordinators own implementation and resources, architects own design.

Source_id/change-readiness is DESIGN ONLY, implementation still parked: w-a6c732bf4bd5 source design859803630edf4fc2b2fd4adbceb491a4 and simplification assessment2ae06d2d31fe46da9e8d62ee62928d43. Prefer a derived readiness view + native evidence association, not a second mutable workflow tracker. Reuse existing typed source schemes until unified producer ships; no new capture/gate/automatic landing or authority. Coordinators own scheduling.

Greg DIRECT active-store task sync (Advisor#83, message51ef7617-4aa2-44e0-b161-2154f38fcbb6, 2026-10-31T16:24:43Z): two independently populated ACTIVE stores must exchange planning both ways, preserve local work, expose concurrent conflicts and keep host-private/live authority local. This is CORE acceptance, not an optional later enhancement. Empty/exact-repeat E1 import and replica pilot successes are first-slice evidence only, not finished sync. Existing implementation owners: w-42885 exchange + w-65fb79ead0c3 divergent/native reconciliation; conversion w-9bf54c91b725 remains separately named/counted and presented. Reconcile against explicit common base and fresh local basis atomically with receipt/progress, never infer absent baseline or delete/overwrite unsent native tasks; no claim transfer or silent revocation. Real two-way pilot starts with independent local tasks on BOTH hosts and demonstrates concurrent same-task conflict, explicit resolution/convergence, preserved local claims/private state. Empty bootstrap remains supported, not required for all joins. Earlier origin/E1 zero-conversion conclusion does not cover model A's conversion. Source_id design is parked; it gates neither sync nor other authorized work.

Native run creation is not execution. Never-claimed generation history proves no work-bound execution only; unbound/OFF/other-generation responsibility needs complete affected-scope proof and an atomic admission fence. Responsible/unknown native collisions retain Stage2/G1/G2. Source ruling c7e164ac on w-65fb.

JOINT G1/G2/G3 import contract is now AGREED DESIGN: ONE complete producer specification Engram w-42d16bae66ac note9c7d13b1f7744b4fbab554012975abb7 (Architect2 concurrence187/d85a12a8, including lazy activation and retirement BEFORE final challenge). It is NOT shipped/enabled or migration authority. Reuse existing original Evaluate/Begin result slots for core-serialized retirement with typed import_reconciliation_retired refusal and durable provenance; preserve actual Evaluate directive vs Begin code shapes, historic bytes and exact mutation replay. Pure outcome/decision reads observe cuts and write nothing. Positive complete scoped owner coverage and persistent host admission fence, settlement, holder-only release/root cleanup, fresh final challenge, then atomic ModelA graph/heads/ONE E1 receipt/decision; absent outcome/quiet host is never settlement. Host persists exact terminal decision before guard removal. TermAl MAIN journal activates descriptor+intent+reader floor durably at FIRST use before remote effect, not install/open; activated guards/floor survive disable/empty/restart, no automatic downgrade. Unknown/nonempty responsibilities cannot use the optional genuinely zero-scope subset to bypass G1/G2 or claim the populated-store pilot. Exact durable inventories/decoder/old-reader conversion and actual implementations remain with coordinators/coders before production use. Read this ONE final body for fields/bounds, not draft history.

Successor authorization source is UNBUILT (joint exact-source ruling w42d noted55946c6da2547f79f0f1a205f54eb90 / TermAl A f2b3a62b9f374e668ca1d79bac192409). No current G2/handoff/channel receipt supplies successor_authorization; ID/chain/labels/origin are not permission. Predecessor access/retirement stays Pending. Supported original-session reconnect is not successor takeover. No new kind or authority widening.
